grammar.en: the topic marker: it says what the rest of the line is about

grammar.en: the object marker: it says what the verb acts on

grammar.en: in, or by means of: in Japanese, in this case
grammar.es: en, o por medio de: en japonés, en este caso

grammar.en: the polite copula, is or am
grammar.es: la cópula cortés, es o soy

grammar.en: the same copula turning the line into a question
